svg.title: Seated Calf Raise: how to perform
svg.desc: Seated with the knee pad on the lower thighs and the balls of the feet on the edge of the step, the heels lower into a deep stretch, pause for one second, then rise as high as possible.
svg.text: Balls of the feet on the edge
Lower the heels into a deep stretch
Rise as high as you can · 1 s
